derivation.run: python3 parse-options.py (paths are repo-relative; run from repo root)
parser_grammar: module header: '^ <Name> (<module_id>)$' preceded by a blank line
category (one-space, whitelist): Audio, Video, Subpictures, Decoders, Input, Stream output, Miscellaneous, Playlist, Hot keys, Hacks
subsection: 3-space indent, usually trailing ':' (one v4l2 subsection ends in ')')
option line: 6-space '--flag' or 2-space '-x, --flag'; name charset [a-zA-Z0-9_+-] (covers hotkey '+' pairs and camelCase like audiobargraph_v-barWidth)
type/choices: '{a, b}' -> enum choices; '<integer [0 .. 200]>' -> type + min/max; '--x, --no-x' -> bool
help: inline after 2+ spaces, else column-33 lines; '(default X)' column-33 line -> default
empty column-33 lines (33 spaces) = empty help slot (chromecast options)
checks_enforced: option sets nested: names(--longhelp) <= names(--advanced --longhelp) <= names(--full-help) (assertion)
parsed option records == raw option-line counts: 615/615, 1476/1476, 1476/1476
leftovers (unparseable non-blank lines) are footer notes only: 3/2/1 across dumps 12/13/14
vlcrc: 1439 name=value lines, 1433 unique names, 6 duplicated names == the 6 name collisions in the help dumps (cross-extraction agreement)
default agreement: 252/252 options declared in both help '(default X)' and vlcrc 'name=X' agree after enabled/disabled->1/0 normalization; 0 disagreements
